comments.value: Would be nice to have it there for consistency and less confusion
Could there be a slider to change avatar volume on individual users, like the current microphone volume slider per person?

I personally usually only use World and Avatar volume sliders - the other sliders are set to a comfortable volume and forgotten.
Additionally, reserving some space for world-specific sliders (video players/BGM anyone?) might be a good idea, if world integration with the UI is to be nice and organic.
I came here to request this too. I need to adjust avatar volume CONSTANTLY. But I have never once touched my personal mic volume, so I can't fathom why they felt that was so important to have there.
Changing the mic device makes a little more sense to have there, but that too is not something most would need to adjust so often that it needs to be one click away like the other options.
Why in the world was it even made this way. The other menu has all three.

details: In the quick menu audio tab, you can change all volume settings except avatars.
title: [1137] No avatar audio setting in QM
